company_description: Mid-size developer platform that provides enterprise code archival + search for large engineering orgs. Heavy focus on searchable code + internal docs for developer workflows. Looking for deterministic query latency and predictable per-query cost; must satisfy SSO/SAML + audit + data residency.
use_case_summary: Primary workload: code search over historical repositories (monorepos + forks) + internal design docs. Approach: vector recall (bi-encoder) over ~200M embeddings -> cross-encoder rerank top-K (K 20-200) for precision-sensitive results. Frequent re-index: daily delta feeds and nightly full snapshot for branches.
indexing_requirements: Target corpus: 120M source files -> ~200M paragraph/chunk embeddings. Expected delta: ~4-8% daily. Need incremental re-indexing within a 4-8 hour window and optional full rebuild weekly. Support for deduplication, canonicalization, and commit-aware vector metadata.
latency_and_throughput_targets: Interactive code search: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 350ms end-to-end (recall+rerank). Throughput: 120 qps sustained across business hours; burst to 500 qps for eng-wide code freeze events.
cost_constraints: Customer target: average end-to-end cost per query (recall + rerank) < $0.01 for normal queries; willing to spend up to $0.03 for heavyweight cross-encoder rerank on top-K. Indexing budget: initial ingestion budget $60k-$120k one-time; ongoing monthly indexing refresh budget $8k-$20k depending on tooling.
retrieval_architecture_notes: Prefer a hybrid: dense-bi-encoder vectors for first-pass recall, then cheap lexical filters for repo/file scoping, and cross-encoder rerank for top-50. Want ability to route rerankers to private GPU pool and fall back to lower-cost quantized reranker for non-critical queries.
security_and_compliance_notes: Must integrate with corporate IdP via SAML; SCIM for provisioning; audit trails for all query events (who/when/indices touched). Data residency requirement: primary storage in us-west region; logs retained 13 months with redaction policy for secrets.
poc_plan: Week 0: security questionnaire + SAML test account; Week 1: ingest 50M embeddings (subset of prod), run baseline recall (ANN) and cross-encoder rerank on dedicated GPUs; Week 2: measure latency, token cost, rerank CPU/GPU utilization; Week 3: tuning (batching, cache configs) + cost projection; Week 4: decision.
